run_learn_kinematics_of_toy: run the toy example that learns kinematics of a 2-link robot model via gradient descent
create_differentiable_robot_model: create a DifferentiableRobotModel from a URDF file path with a given name and device
make_link_param_learnable: make a robot link parameter like translation learnable using an UnconstrainedTensor
compute_forward_kinematics: compute forward kinematics to predict end-effector position given joint angles q
generate_random_forward_kinematics_data: generate random forward kinematics training data with joint angles and end-effector positions
